keyword: when was the last moon mission

verifications.claim: The last time humans went to the moon was during NASA's Apollo 17 mission.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "Apollo 17 — the final mission in the program, which was the last time humans traveled to the moon." (R3); "Apollo 17 was the sixth and final Apollo mission to land people on the moon." (R1); "The last crewed mission to the Moon was Apollo 17" (R4)
verifications.reasoning: Multiple sources directly state Apollo 17 as the last human moon mission.

verifications.claim: NASA's Apollo 17 mission landed on December 11, 1972.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "Apollo 17 landed on the Moon in the valley of Taurus-Littrow on December 11, 1972." (R7)
verifications.reasoning: R7 directly states the exact landing date.

verifications.claim: NASA's Apollo 17 mission returned to Earth on December 19, 1972.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "On Dec. 19, 1972, splashdown" (R6); "splashed down in the Pacific Ocean on December 19, 1972" (R7); "taking place between 7 and 19 December 1972" (R4)
verifications.reasoning: Sources confirm the splashdown/return date as December 19, 1972.
